title: In a brass band every player has a part that matters, and some bands teach complete beginners
alt: A brass cornet with three valves standing on a shiny table, its bell to the right, reflected in the surface below.

posts.facebook:
Some brass bands will teach you from scratch.

A British-style brass band has around 28 to 30 players: cornets, tenor horns, baritones, euphoniums, trombones, basses and percussion. Every player has a part that matters.

In Belfast, Northern Ireland, a band called Downshire Brass runs Couch to Concert: 12 weeks for adults with no brass experience, with an instrument to use and a concert at the end. In the US, New Horizons bands at local colleges take adults who have never played an instrument.

Which instrument would you pick?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/join-a-brass-band/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
